CustomObject.label: OI Org Health Metric Config
CustomObject.description: Per-metric weight/threshold/formula configuration, one generic type reused across every section that needs a configurable number (deliberately not one mdt per section, per ADR-0026) — the structural mechanism that keeps "any score must expose formula" true by construction, since Formula_Description__c is read directly by the DTO that feeds oiHealthFormulaDisclosure. No records shipped in the Storage/Org Overview vertical slice (Phase 1) — populated starting with Metadata Health (Phase 2), which is the first section with admin-configurable thresholds.
